The has arrived with , all set to leave you stunned! The first- single from the magnum-opus directed by A.R.Murugadoss starring Vijay is the sublime- folk number that would get your feet-tapping! With A.R.Rahman’s trademark uniqueness and Vivek’s novel Chennai Tamil slang, this one produced by Sun Pictures is sure to get you singing ‘World-u mothamum arla vudanum pisthe!’.
